description: Proposer-visible AutomationBench finance search split. Stratified sample of the 50-task evolution pool from the gpt-5.5 baseline, matched to the overall aa mean and failure-mode distribution. The proposer may read traces from this split.
selection_method: 50-task evolution pool sampled from the 100-task finance baseline to match overall aa mean + failure modes, then split 30/20 (seed=42, greedy-best-of-60000).
